notes: How much a given metric matters on a given instance.
This is the file db-ops init writes, not a sample: it is read as it stands. data/metric_importance_overrides.example.json carries worked examples of the parts that ship empty.
'scale' is the product's own vocabulary and ships in force, so an override written here means the same thing on every node.

'instance_overrides' ships empty. Importance is the one judgement no default can make: the same metric is a shrug on a lab box and a page at 3am on the instance the business runs on, and only the operator knows which is which.
